lyrics.ja: 朝早くに目がさめて
lyrics.romaji: Asa Hayaku ni Me ga Samete
lyrics.en: I wake up early in the morning

lyrics.ja: ジメッとした服着替えて
lyrics.en: Change out of my damp clothes

lyrics.ja: 犬を散歩に連れて行って
lyrics.romaji: Inu wo Sanpo ni Tsurete Itte
lyrics.en: Take the dog out for a walk

lyrics.ja: すれ違う少年たち
lyrics.en: Boys passing by

lyrics.ja: 缶コーヒー自販機で買う
lyrics.en: I buy a canned coffee from the vending machine
lyrics.zh: 在自動販賣機買了罐裝咖啡

lyrics.ja: 間違えて無糖にしてしまった
lyrics.en: I accidentally got the unsweetened one

lyrics.ja: 苦い思いしたくないのに
lyrics.en: Even though I don't want to feel bitter

lyrics.ja: まだ寝ぼけてるのかな
lyrics.en: Am I still half asleep?

lyrics.ja: そんなはずないのに意識してるのかな
lyrics.romaji: Sonna Hazu Nai no ni Ishiki Shiteru no Kana
lyrics.en: There's no way that's it, but am I thinking about it?
lyrics.zh: 明明不該是這樣，卻還是在意著嗎

lyrics.ja: 8月の魔物が影を潜めている
lyrics.romaji: Hachigatsu no Mamono ga Kage wo Hisomete Iru
lyrics.en: The monster of August is lurking in the shadows
lyrics.zh: 八月的魔物正潛伏在暗處

lyrics.ja: 揺れ動く気持ち逆らい続けては
lyrics.en: If I keep resisting these wavering feelings
lyrics.zh: 若繼續抗拒這動搖的心情

lyrics.ja: 何も変わらないから
lyrics.en: Nothing will change

lyrics.ja: 勇気を出して進もう
lyrics.en: Let's be brave and move forward

lyrics.ja: 晴れた日は外へ出よう
lyrics.romaji: Hareta Hi ha Soto e Deyou
lyrics.en: On sunny days, let's go outside

lyrics.ja: トキメキと出会えるかな
lyrics.en: I wonder if I'll encounter some excitement

lyrics.ja: 海まで歩いてみようかな
lyrics.en: Maybe I'll try walking to the sea
lyrics.zh: 要不要試著走到海邊呢

lyrics.ja: 日焼け止め忘れずに
lyrics.en: Don't forget the sunscreen

lyrics.ja: なびく香りまとわりつく
lyrics.en: A wafting scent clings to me

lyrics.ja: なんだか懐かしい記憶から
lyrics.en: From somehow nostalgic memories

lyrics.ja: 不意に涙切ないよね
lyrics.romaji: Fui ni Namida Setsunai yo ne
lyrics.en: Suddenly tears—it's heartbreaking, isn't it
lyrics.zh: 突然落淚，真令人難受呢

lyrics.ja: 飛んでくる砂のせい
lyrics.en: It's the fault of the blowing sand

lyrics.ja: 忘れかけていた言葉つぶやいては
lyrics.en: Muttering words I had almost forgotten
lyrics.zh: 低喃著快要忘記的話語

lyrics.ja: 迷走する日々をいつまでくりかえす
lyrics.romaji: Meisou Suru Hibi wo Itsu made Kurikaesu
lyrics.en: How long will I keep repeating these wandering days?
lyrics.zh: 迷走的日常究竟要重複到何時

lyrics.ja: 暑さにやられておかしくなったかな
lyrics.romaji: Atsusa ni Yararete Okashiku Natta Kana
lyrics.en: Maybe the heat has gotten to me and made me strange
lyrics.zh: 是不是被炎熱曬到不正常了

lyrics.ja: 頭冷やさないとね
lyrics.en: I need to cool my head

lyrics.ja: 猛暑でもうしょうもないな
lyrics.romaji: Mousho de Mou Shou mo Nai na
lyrics.en: With this intense heat, there's nothing I can do
lyrics.zh: 酷暑讓人拿它沒辦法啊

lyrics.ja: 夜の風に流れてくる
lyrics.romaji: Yoru no Kaze ni Nagarete Kuru
lyrics.en: Drifting in on the night wind

lyrics.ja: 線香花火のにおい感じ
lyrics.en: I sense the scent of sparklers
lyrics.zh: 聞到了線香花火的味道

lyrics.ja: 夏の終わりもうすぐかな
lyrics.romaji: Natsu no Owari Mou Sugu Kana
lyrics.en: Is the end of summer coming soon?

lyrics.ja: やり残してばかりで
lyrics.en: Leaving so much unfinished

lyrics.ja: そんなはずないのに意識してるのかな
lyrics.romaji: Sonna Hazu Nai no ni Ishiki Shiteru no Kana
lyrics.en: There's no way that's it, but am I thinking about it?
lyrics.zh: 明明不該是這樣，卻還是在意著嗎

lyrics.ja: 8月の魔物が影を潜めている
lyrics.romaji: Hachigatsu no Mamono ga Kage wo Hisomete Iru
lyrics.en: The monster of August is lurking in the shadows
lyrics.zh: 八月的魔物正潛伏在暗處

lyrics.ja: 揺れ動く気持ち逆らい続けてないで
lyrics.romaji: Yureugoku Kimochi Sakurai Tsuzukete Nai de
lyrics.en: Don't keep resisting these wavering feelings
lyrics.zh: 別再抗拒這動搖的心情

lyrics.ja: 今すぐ始めれば間に合うから踏み出して
lyrics.romaji: Ima Sugu Hajimereba Maniau kara Fumidashite
lyrics.en: If you start right now, you'll make it, so take a step forward
lyrics.zh: 現在開始就還來得及，邁出那一步吧
